title: Topometric Indices And Corneal Densitometry Change After Corneal Refractive Surgery Combined With Simultaneous Collagen Crosslinking

license.statement: Dove Medical Press terms incorporating CC BY-NC 3.0 unported (article <license>)

indication: myopia in patients considered at high risk of ectasia (any of: age under 30, thinnest pachymetry under 500 um, myopia over 6.0 D, astigmatism over 1.5 D); every eye had simultaneous accelerated CXL

groups.description: All 25 eyes of 14 patients: PRK Xtra (5 eyes, MEL 90), LASIK Xtra (8 eyes, VisuMax flap) and SMILE Xtra (12 eyes), each with simultaneous accelerated CXL (0.22% riboflavin, UVA 30 mW/cm2 for 90 s); follow-up tabulated for all eyes combined only

series.notes: mean ± SD; records with less than 6 months of follow-up were excluded; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: T0001 MRSE by procedure (PRK Xtra, LASIK Xtra, SMILE Xtra)
exclusions.reason: preoperative only; follow-up is not tabulated by procedure
the same preoperative values as T0002 Day 0, which is cited
topographic indices and densitometry, not refraction

notes: Single-arm case series: every eye received prophylactic accelerated CXL with the refractive procedure, an adjunct beyond the standard procedure, so the group is recorded treated.
Procedure context other: PRK, LASIK and SMILE eyes are pooled in the tabulated follow-up.
Day 0 is the preoperative baseline: the T0002 Day 0 MRSE cell repeats the T0001 baseline cell and the text compares later visits with preoperative values.
Eyes are described as at high risk of ectasia; no keratoconus or other ectatic disease is reported among the included eyes.
One LASIK Xtra eye developed infectious keratitis; no eye is reported as removed from the analysis.
Both eyes of some patients are included (25 eyes of 14 patients); the series combines them.
Mixed linear models produced the p-values; tabulated values are mean ± SD.
UCVA, CDVA, keratometry, Q-value, pachymetry, HOA, topographic indices and densitometry are tabulated but not extracted.
